title: Letter grid
tagline: Find words in a grid of letters before time runs out.
teaser: A grid of letter cubes, three minutes and as many words as you can trace through neighbouring letters.

manPage.synopsis: letters — trace words through touching letters before the time is up.
manPage.description: Barry Brachman of the University of British Columbia wrote the original word-search game for BSD.

howToPlay: Find words by tracing through touching letters.
Each letter can be used once per word.
Find as many as you can before time runs out.
